content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Science and Astronomy 's PostScience and Astronomy 2d · Shared with Public One of the most ancient meteor showers ever documented is reaching its peak—and this year, the viewing conditions couldn’t be much better.With minimal moonlight to wash out the sky, the darkness will help even faint streaks stand out. If the weather stays clear, it’s a great chance to step outside, look up, and catch nature’s quiet light show.Find a spot away from city lights, give your eyes a few minutes to adjust, and just watch. Sometimes the simplest moments under the night sky turn out to be the most memorable.Clear Skies Everyone!
